description: Figure 7, titled “Micro F1 (%) of KnowPrompt using different numbers of training samples generated by LLMs,” is a line plot illustrating the performance of the KnowPrompt model as a function of the number of generated training samples. The x-axis, labeled “Number of Generated Samples,” is on a linear scale and ranges from 8 to 64, with tick marks at 8, 16, 32, and 64. The y-axis, labeled “Micro F1 (%)”, is also on a linear scale and spans from 0% to 100%, with major tick marks at intervals of 20%. A single solid blue line traces the performance trend: starting at approximately 78% Micro F1 at 8 samples, it rises to about 82% at 16 samples, peaks near 85% at 32 samples, and then slightly declines to roughly 83% at 64 samples. The plot visually conveys that performance improves with more samples up to K=32, after which additional samples yield diminishing returns.
